title: Big English 3 Student Book — Units 1–9 Book Intelligence (A+B)
notes: Experimental Phase 2 interpretation for local read-only UI preview. Content taken from the preferred BE3 A+B overview Units 1–9. Not Phase 1 evidence; not merged into canonical/v1.json; format not locked. Source Markdown: docs/phase-2/experiments/be3-sb-u01-u09-book-overview-d017-exp-ab.md. Contract: docs/phase-2/book-intelligence-ui-data-contract-v1.md.

units.title: Wake Up!
units.vocabulary: Daily routines; clock times beyond o’clock (seven thirty, seven forty-five…); parts of day; hygiene content words
units.grammar_structures: When does…? at… / in the morning…; before/after; frequency adverbs (always–never); subject + verb sentences
units.communicative_functions: Talk about routine times; sequence with before/after; state habit frequency
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about daily routines and times; use frequency adverbs for habits; identify subjects and verbs when writing about routines; talk about keeping clean / chores timing
units.clil_culture: Science: Keep It Clean (germs); Culture: time zones / e-pals

units.title: A Lot of Jobs!
units.vocabulary: Jobs (firefighter, nurse, scientist…); workplaces (hospital, farm, laboratory…); creative-job words
units.grammar_structures: What does he do? / Where does he work?; full present simple (aff/neg/Wh/Y-N); compound subjects/verbs
units.communicative_functions: Ask/answer about jobs and workplaces; ask personal information questions; offer polite help
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about jobs and workplaces; ask/answer present-simple personal questions; produce compound sentences with two subjects and two verbs; show respect to others
units.clil_culture: Social science: creative jobs; Culture: making communities better

units.title: Working Hard!
units.vocabulary: Chores (make my bed, walk the dog, do the dishes…); pocket-money words
units.grammar_structures: have to / has to; frequency with chores; like/love/hate + -ing; can for requests/help
units.communicative_functions: State obligations; express chore preferences; ask for/offer/refuse help
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about chores and obligations; say what I like/hate doing; ask for and give help; capitalize paragraph titles correctly
units.clil_culture: Math: pocket money; Culture: children helping family work

units.title: Amazing Animals
units.vocabulary: Animals (bear, camel, shark…); habitats (desert, rain forest, ocean…); camouflage / pet words
units.grammar_structures: Where do … live?; can/can't abilities; adverbs of manner; habitat corrections
units.communicative_functions: Talk about habitats and abilities; discuss pet suitability; describe manner
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about animals and abilities; talk about where animals live; write a clear topic sentence for a paragraph; talk about protecting animals/habitats
units.clil_culture: Science: camouflage; Culture: pets in different places

units.title: Wonderful Weather!
units.vocabulary: Weather (windy, snowy, rainy…); clothes for weather; climate words
units.grammar_structures: What's the weather like today?; What was it like yesterday?; was/were; There was/were
units.communicative_functions: Describe present/past weather; link clothes to weather; discuss climates
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about weather and clothes; talk about past weather with was/were; support a topic with detail sentences; prepare for the weather
units.clil_culture: Geography: changing climates; Culture: all-weather fun

units.title: Smells Good!
units.vocabulary: Sense verbs (look/sound/smell/taste/feel); sensory adjectives (delicious, tight, rough…)
units.grammar_structures: Sense verb + adjective; How does/do …?; would like to; invitations
units.communicative_functions: Describe sensory qualities; play guessing games; express preferences; invite
units.learning_outcomes: Describe how things look/sound/smell/taste/feel; talk about animal senses; close a paragraph with a final sentence that restates the main idea; try new things
units.clil_culture: Science: senses keep us safe; Culture: how jobs smell

units.title: Fabulous Food!
units.vocabulary: Sandwich/pizza foods; vitamin/nutrition words; breakfast foods worldwide
units.grammar_structures: There is/are + some/any; quantifiers (a lot of, a few, a little, much, many); How much/How many?
units.communicative_functions: Talk about food existence/quantity; describe eating habits; discuss nutrition
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about food with some/any and quantifiers; ask how much/how many; write a short paragraph with title, topic, details, and closing; talk about healthy eating / trying foods
units.phonics: br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr
units.writing: Paragraph parts — title / topic / detail / final

units.title: Healthy Living
units.vocabulary: Healthy/unhealthy habits; calorie/fitness words; unusual sports words
units.grammar_structures: Past simple questions with Did…?; regular/irregular past (played, went, saw…); and/but/or
units.communicative_functions: Ask about past healthy habits; narrate past actions; combine ideas
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about past healthy/unhealthy actions; use regular/irregular past forms; join related ideas using and, but, or or; talk about getting exercise
units.writing: Sentence combining with and, but, or

units.title: School Trips!
units.vocabulary: Places to visit (museum, aquarium, zoo…); past trip verbs (went, saw, ate…); art/theater words
units.grammar_structures: Past simple Wh/Y-N (Where did you go? / Did you…?); didn't + base; SVO sentence order
units.communicative_functions: Narrate past trips; contrast what was/wasn't done; identify sentence parts
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about past school trips and places visited; use past affirmative/negative; write past-tense SVO sentences about trips; recognize talents
units.clil_culture: Art: art gallery; Culture: world stage / theater
